feeds.title: Tomplanmytrip.com » SeeColombia Travel
feeds.description: The Colombia Travel Blog is the only travel blog you'll need to plan your visit to Colombia. Our team of international travelers is passionate about showing off the magic and diversity of Colombia to the world.

feeds.title: Magic Tour Colombia Blog
feeds.description: Magic Tour Colombia is a contemporary company, committed to Traditional Cultures and Sacred Territories. It has an excellent group of local guides trained to offer the best adventure in terms of information Ethnocultural, Botanical, Archaeological and Ecological Walks. We share the best tips and recommendations when visiting Colombia on our blog.

feeds.title: BnB Colombia Tours Blog
feeds.description: At BnB Colombia Tours, we've got the tours, the guides, the transportation, the accommodation, the expert local knowledge, and the complete logistics ready to provide you with your dream Colombian experience! Read interesting facts, stats, and information about everything you'll need to know before coming to Colombia on our blog.

feeds.title: Colombia Reports » Travel
feeds.description: Colombia Reports is Colombia's largest and most reliable news source in English. We are Colombia Reports travel news for tourists, visitors, and tourism providers. We will tell you everything on destinations, trends and challenges.

feeds.title: Wanderluluu Blog
feeds.description: Wanderluluu is an award-nominated Colombia travel blog on a mission to debunk the myth that the world is a scary place for female travelers. These travel guides will help you achieve your solo travel ambitions.

feeds.title: Pelecanus Blog
feeds.description: We invite you to travel the country with our travel blogs. We have travelled around the country to find the best experiences and to be able to offer you advice to make your experience great. In our Colombia Travel Blogs, you will find valuable information about Colombia. Where to go in, where to eat, travel guides of different Colombian regions and whatever information you can imagine.

feeds.title: Sarepa.com
feeds.description: Sarepa is a travel blog all about traveling through and living in Colombia created by a regular suitcase packer and cafe loiterer, by Sarah Duncan. It is a documentation of his love affair with Colombia and is his way of saying thank you to a country and a people that has given him so many wonderful memories.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Colombia holidays
feeds.description: Follow these blog entries and articles about Colombia including travel tips, events, attractions, apartment and vacation rental tips from the Guardian, the world's leading liberal voice.

feeds.title: Medellin Living
feeds.description: Medellin Living is a Colombia travel blog highlighting the local culture and nightlife, with travel and living tips for visitors and expats. A fun look at nightlife and culture in Colombia's most beautiful city.
